card.name: Start of a word split after a space
card.fires_on: Responds to a word-start piece that begins a word split into parts, such as prote in protegido, Sim in Simulect or Simultaneous, Cor in Corbridge. Also fires on blank gaps between title and Spanish translation.

modes.label: Spanish word starts
modes.description: First piece of a Spanish word in a Spanish label or text, such as prote- or pare-.
modes.example: Mantener el medicamento<< prote>>gido del calor, luz y hum

modes.label: Sim- and similar word starts
modes.description: First piece of an English word or brand name split into parts, mostly Sim-, Cor-, MY-.
modes.example: as severe hypersensitivity reactions to<< Sim>>ulect or graft loss occur.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are a scattered mix (odd, off, Chinese characters), so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the first piece of a long word that the model has cut into parts, mainly Spanish words and words starting with Sim.
